finding: Gboard showed its clipboard-history suggestion list (four entries, including personal items from earlier host clipboard contents, not the harmless string the human placed for this run) below the focused SearchBar in 1 of 180 distinct F4 frames: F4-G05-1.3-filter-return, one of the eleven original font-scale-1.3 frames the executor marked invalid after the overlapping-helper incident (tooling-incidents.json). The list is absent from all UI XML, logs, receipts, the checkpoint, the run stream and the run directory (text search of every non-PNG file found none of its content). The frame's raw screenshot receipt (0467-...-screenshot.stdout.bin) is byte-identical to the PNG and is redacted with it. capture-index.json, commands.jsonl and the receipt keep the executor's pre-redaction hashes; sha256After below is authoritative for the committed files.
detection: Coordinator visual inspection of all 180 distinct F4 frames via 15 contact sheets, then a full-resolution crop with a coordinate grid for the affected frame. Every other SearchBar-focused frame (F4-K-*, F4-R02-*, *-1.3-*, *-1.3-rerun-*) shows only the floating Gboard toolbar or the full floating keyboard with no clipboard content. A byte comparison of every *.stdout.bin receipt in a-gates, b-device, g-settings, g-settings2, f-device and f-device2 against the saved PNGs found the receipts listed here as the only raw screenshots with unredacted content.
originals: Unredacted originals were moved outside version control to the git-ignored /_backup_ns07_redaction/f-device2/ and /_backup_ns07_redaction/f-device/ folders (*.unredacted.png, *.unredacted.stdout.bin); they are never committed.
